scope: Deduplicated discovery index; raw handoffs retain source claims, published stop order and access limits. Entries include nearby comparisons, broad areas and individual buildings, not 84 selected stops.
mergePolicy: Coordinator inspected names and context; 17 clear cross-handoff aliases merged. Broad site/specific building and ambiguous street/building combinations remain distinct with relationships. Every raw place maps once. Source-family repetition is not corroboration.

tourDeduplication.note: Both researchers opened it; only local-context.json extracts its itinerary.
